sources.title: OpenMagnetics / PSMA MAS
sources.redistribution: permitted (Apache-2.0); most values originate from manufacturer datasheets whose own terms are not covered by the MAS licence

sources.title: Princeton MagNet (packaged scalar databases)
sources.redistribution: permitted (MIT; citation of the TPEL papers requested)

sources.title: Princeton MagNet website B-H waveform downloads (<material>_cycle.zip / _measurements.zip)
sources.redistribution: permitted, but there is no stable URL or checksum (Streamlit per-session downloads)
sources.reason: No pinnable download: the existing user-supplied adapter (PrincetonMagnetAdapter.import_website_zip) converts a manually downloaded zip into v0.2 waveform records with SHA-256; nothing is committed.

sources.title: MagNet Challenge 2023 (MC1) data
sources.reason: The 10-material training link is deleted; validation (256 MB) and testing (1.2 GB, materials A-E) Dropbox bundles carry no licence and are not pinned. The 10 training materials are the MagNet website data (see princeton_magnet_waveforms).

sources.title: MagNet Challenge 2 / MagNetX database
sources.redistribution: not permitted without permission (no LICENSE file; contact pelsmagnet@gmail.com)
sources.reason: No licence; the MagNetX database is a 24.8 GB unlicensed Dropbox archive. The existing read-only adapter (MagnetChallenge2Adapter) imports user-supplied files locally; nothing is downloaded or committed.

sources.title: Paderborn University LEA materialdatabase
sources.redistribution: permitted under GPL-3.0 as a separate copyleft subtree (LICENSE, NOTICE, source offer)

sources.title: Paderborn MagNet-Hub
sources.reason: Model zoo (trained MagNet Challenge models) plus two small test fixtures, not a measurement dataset; the fixture adapter stays available, model inference belongs to AIPE-Magnetics-Design.

sources.title: PSMA / Dartmouth Core Loss Studies (Pilot, Phase II, Phase III)
sources.redistribution: not permitted: reproduction requires written PSMA consent (https://www.psma.com/legal/copyright-statement)
sources.reason: Redistribution prohibited. A user-supplied-file adapter (aipe_magnetics_database.ingest.external.psma_coreloss_db) reads a locally downloaded Phase II coreloss.db into records that stay on the user's machine. Note: 'dPhi' is documented as peak flux [T] but its values are peak flux in Wb (peak B = dPhi / Ae); 'Ecyc' is energy per cycle of the whole core in J.

sources.title: EMPIR 19ENG06 HEFMAG amorphous / nanocrystalline loss and complex permeability
SMC and Mn-Zn ferrite loss under symmetric / asymmetric triangular polarization
ASU MAPEL MHz core-loss aggregate dataset
sources.reason: No licence. A user-supplied-file adapter (aipe_magnetics_database.ingest.external.asu_mhz_csv) normalises a local copy of MHzCoreLoss.csv (952 rows) and keeps the 13 original study labels as underlying_source so aggregated rows are never counted as independent of the original publications.

sources.title: AMPED / University of Pittsburgh / DOE-NETL high-frequency magnetics data
sources.reason: No public tabular dataset with a verifiable licence was found (NETL EDX, OSTI, Zenodo searched); only two datasheet PDFs with unverified terms.
